meta.name: baoyu-post-to-wechat
meta.description: Posts content to WeChat Official Account (微信公众号) via API or Chrome CDP. Supports article posting (文章) with HTML, markdown, or plain text input, and image-text posting (贴图, formerly 图文) with multiple images. Markdown article workflows default to converting ordinary external links into bottom citations for WeChat-friendly output. Use when user mentions "发布公众号", "post to wechat", "微信公众号", or "贴图/图文/文章".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容自动发布到微信公众号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将文章或图文发布到微信公众号
copy.tagline_en: Automatically publish content to WeChat Official Account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to post articles or images to WeChat Official Account

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你把文章或图片内容发布到微信公众号。支持文章（HTML、Markdown、纯文本）和贴图（多张图片）两种形式。Markdown 文章会自动把外部链接转为底部引用。
howto.when: 当你提到“发布公众号”、“post to wechat”、“微信公众号”或“贴图/图文/文章”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这篇 Markdown 文章发布到公众号。
say.note: Claude 会引导你选择发布方式并完成发布。

say.text: 发布一个贴图，图片在 ./images/ 文件夹里。
say.note: Claude 会调用浏览器脚本发布图文消息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you post articles or image-text content to a WeChat Official Account. It supports articles (HTML, Markdown, plain text) and image-text posts (multiple images). For Markdown articles, external links are converted to bottom citations by default.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "发布公众号", "post to wechat", "微信公众号", or "贴图/图文/文章".

say_en.text: Publish this Markdown article to WeChat Official Account.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through method selection and publishing.

say_en.text: Post an image-text with images from ./images/ folder.
say_en.note: Claude will use the browser script to publish the image-text post.
